<BrickTagName
  name={"eo-markdown-editor"}
  alias={["markdown.markdown-editor"]}
  insider={false}
  deprecated={false}
/>

markdown 编辑器

## Examples

### Basic

```yaml preview
- brick: eo-markdown-editor
  properties:
    value: |-
      # Markdown

      > Content.

      ![image.png](data:image/png;base64,)
  events:
    markdown.value.change:
      action: console.log
      args:
        - change
        - <% EVENT.detail %>
    image.upload:
      action: console.log
      args:
        - upload
        - <% EVENT.detail %>
# -- YAML HEADING DELIMITER start (1nbbm8) --
markdown/eo-markdown-editor/basic
# -- YAML HEADING DELIMITER end (1nbbm8) --
# -- YAML DELIMITER (1nbbm8) --
# <eo-markdown-editor
#   value="# Markdown
# 
# &gt; Content.
# 
# ![image.png](data:image/png;base64,)"
#   id="brick-1"
# ></eo-markdown-editor>
# 
# <script>
#   const brick_1 = document.getElementById("brick-1");
#   brick_1.addEventListener("markdown.value.change", (e) => {
#     console.log("change", e.detail);
#   });
#   brick_1.addEventListener("image.upload", (e) => {
#     console.log("upload", e.detail);
#   });
# </script>
# 
```

### Table

### With Form

```yaml preview
- brick: eo-form
  events:
    validate.success:
      - action: console.log
    values.change:
      - action: console.log
  children:
    - brick: eo-markdown-editor
      properties:
        name: markdown
        label: markdown
        required: true
    - brick: eo-submit-buttons
# -- YAML HEADING DELIMITER start (1nbbm8) --
markdown/eo-markdown-editor/with form
# -- YAML HEADING DELIMITER end (1nbbm8) --
# -- YAML DELIMITER (1nbbm8) --
# <eo-form id="brick-1">
#   <eo-markdown-editor
#     name="markdown"
#     label="markdown"
#     required
#   ></eo-markdown-editor>
#   <eo-submit-buttons></eo-submit-buttons>
# </eo-form>
# 
# <script>
#   const brick_1 = document.getElementById("brick-1");
#   brick_1.addEventListener("validate.success", (e) => {
#     console.log(e.detail);
#   });
#   brick_1.addEventListener("values.change", (e) => {
#     console.log(e.detail);
#   });
# </script>
# 
```
